atoms.reason: Two-proposal consensus (A,C) on a foundational, well-bounded module. Per-camera persistence under runs/scene/<camera_id>/ with three clear subcomponents is sound and high-impact; the test names a concrete file/path, giving strong specificity. Three subcomponents add modest complexity, slightly lowering simplicity.

A,B consensus. Atomic write-temp-then-rename, per-component schema_version, and tolerant loaders are best-practice and directly reduce corruption/migration risk. Highly specific (formats, atomicity, versioning). Supporting rather than headline impact; multiple artifacts add slight complexity.

Full A,B,C consensus. Per-cell EMA in steady state with median bootstrap and a motion-gated update is standard, correct background modeling; gating on no active moving track prevents plate contamination. EMA + median bootstrap + gating is moderately complex, lowering simplicity.

A,C consensus. Fixed 16x12 grid with confidence-weighted class persistence is a reasonable, bounded heuristic and concretely testable. Correctness is good but heuristic (thresholds for 'normal' unspecified), and it contributes only one of the two suppression conditions, capping impact and risk_reduction.

A,B consensus and a key correctness insight: keying on a spatial+class signature (bbox IoU + YOLO class + persistence) rather than ephemeral track_id is the right model, with promotion only after a warmup-spanning threshold. High implementation cost (IoU matching, dedup, hit-count tracking) lowers feasibility and simplicity.

A,C consensus. Minimal, surgical change to events/builder.py to forward _static_track_ids keeps event semantics intact, which is low-cost, simple, and low-risk. Impact is supporting (a data-flow enabler) rather than headline.

A,C consensus on the correct integration point: hooking the VLM-gate decision rather than detector inference confines blast radius and keeps detection untouched. Low-cost, simple, and clearly testable.

Full A,B,C consensus and the payoff atom. Fail-open, READY-state-only, requiring BOTH furniture IoU-match AND ~0 plate-delta, with shadow-mode 'would-have-woken' counters, is an exemplary safety design — maximal impact and risk_reduction with high specificity. Dual conditions + fail-open + shadow metrics + state-gating make it the most complex/costly item, lowering simplicity and feasibility.

A,C consensus. A 2-5 minute warmup before suppression activates prevents premature, under-informed gating and pairs naturally with the READY-state requirement of atom_08. The 2-5 min range is a band rather than a fixed value, slightly reducing specificity.

Full A,B,C consensus. The ~8-atom decomposition with per-atom unit tests, chapter grouping, and architect review before assembly is sound process that de-risks delivery; it enumerates the exact atoms, giving high specificity. Process work yields indirect (not headline) impact.

Full A,B,C consensus. Gating atoms on their own unit tests and chapters on the full oko pytest suite plus a synthetic frames->tracks->SceneModel->decision E2E fixture is strong verification; correctly notes bridge-smoke alone is insufficient. Building the E2E fixture costs effort, slightly lowering feasibility.

Single-source (B) but a strong design refinement: a pure SceneModel (no I/O in update paths) with lifecycle isolated in a SceneStore and only thin read/feed hooks in builder.py/live.py greatly improves testability and separation of concerns, complementing atoms 01/06/07. Adds a SceneStore layer, modestly lowering simplicity.

Single-source (B) but valuable for a long-running per-camera service: fixed grid, LRU/persistence-based registry eviction, throttled saves, and periodic compaction bound memory/disk growth and protect against unbounded accumulation. Secondary to core functionality, so impact is moderate.

Single-source (C). The motivation — capturing and durably persisting _static_track_ids instead of discarding them per-event — is valid but is already covered by atom_06 (forwarding) plus atom_05 (the registry). Taken literally it risks keying on raw track_id, which directly contradicts atom_05's spatial+class-signature requirement. Modify to explicitly route the captured static tracks into the signature-keyed registry of atom_05; redundancy penalty applied.
